graded_by: vision-capable agent inspecting the rendered PNGs directly against benchmarks/g3/fault-injection/visual-judge/RUBRIC.md, which was written before any fixture image was rendered or seen. No API client and no credential — decision 017 governs the automatic in-loop judge (usecases/verify_visual.py, driven headless with no agent attached), not a one-off offline grading of a fixed 8-case suite.
independence_caveat: NOT the independent judge AD-13 specifies: the grading agent also drove the designer loop. Bounded — parts authored before any judge existed, rubric predates every image — but a clean AD-13 measurement needs a separate model or separate context.
low_confidence: Wilson 95% CI on sensitivity at n=5 is [0.566, 1.000]; the lower bound is far below the 0.95 bar. At this n one miss gives 0.800 and one flagged control 0.333, so the suite falsifies an obviously broken judge but cannot demonstrate the AD-13 bars.
